about: H3f mutants of hosts/mygo and its drawing module. scripts/mutants measures the Ergo module only; each edit here is applied to a scratch copy of the repository without .git (the layout tests build bin/ergo from it; an H2L mutant edits std ui/layout, which only hosts/mygo's oracle holds to MyGo), then, when the edit is to drawing/internal/drawgen, drawgen runs in drawing/ (as go generate would after the edit), then the killers run. A killer is module:Test, where module is drawing or mygo.

mutants.rule: every exported constant of a drawing-layer package is mirrored

mutants.name: H3f-args-reordered
mutants.rule: a wrapper calls the internal function with its parameters in order

mutants.name: H3f-layer-dropped

mutants.name: GP3c-outputs-unreported
